title: Sprint tooling runs in any project from the plugin
goal: The backlog and sprint loop (items, claims, gates, stall signals, brief, dispatch, land, close) runs in any git project that installs the it-ops-kb plugin and writes a backlog.json: the kb is one such project, with its current behaviour as the default config; a worker's brief is generated by a command and carries the rules of the project's own docs and the kb's facts on headless sessions, not the project's whole rulebook; a multi-repository workspace lands an item as one merge request per repository read once from the forge, never polled; cost says when it cannot measure; and the proof is one item of a second project run end to end on the plugin's /sprint, whose retrospective findings come back as kb items. Overrides the parking of orchestration features in EP-gzr4mmkm by the operator's decision of 2026-10-10.
